title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Fresh Pineapple 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Escape to a tropical paradise with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Fresh Pineapple. This e-liquid embodies the essence of pure, sun-ripened pineapple—sweet, tangy, and incredibly refreshing. The moment you inhale, the vivid taste of fresh pineapple envelops your taste buds, as if you're biting into a slice of this succulent fruit right on the beach. It's a flavour that instantly invigorates your senses and sets the tone for a genuinely uplifting vaping experience. As the sweet notes make way for a subtle tartness, you'll realise this isn't just another fruity vape; it's a meticulously balanced flavour profile that mirrors the complexity of real pineapple. The rich, multi-dimensional taste will have you hooked, as it brilliantly recreates the sensation of sipping a refreshing pineapple smoothie under the swaying palm trees. Whether you're a tropical flavour enthusiast or simply looking to try something new and exceptional, Fresh Pineapple offers an unparalleled vaping experience. Its exquisite balance of sweetness and acidity ensures that every hit is as exciting as the first. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
